title: Portrait dossier card: identity top-left, figure centre, notes panel below a divider
use: One image that explains one subject: name, attributes, full figure, abilities. Social portrait post or the first screen of a long image.

fonts.latinDisplay: lettering.cjs: code-drawn glyphs (A-Z, 0-9, space and / \ - _ + . , : ; [ ] < > | # % ! ? ' " & €), rendered as paths; other characters make the slot fall back to the CJK font and are reported
fonts.licence: Source Han Sans/Serif and Noto Sans/Serif CJK: SIL Open Font License 1.1
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. Install them where the SVG or PNG is rendered. check measures <text> with an advance model calibrated in headless Chrome against Noto Sans / Serif CJK SC at the weights the layouts use; other fonts can be wider.

accent_text.use: highlight sentence (the accent hue darkened to pass 4.5:1 on the panel)

accent_max_share.note: accent-colour area budget as a share of the canvas; measured on the render

guides.note: show safe zones, figure zones and alignment lines in the output

figure.note: full body, feet near the divider

relations: Three bands: identity in the top third, figure in the middle, notes below one divider (0.712H).
All text left-aligned to the frame's inner edge + 1%.
decoration: Range grid icon, corner tag; the large geometric watermark of the samples is not drawn.
changesFromStudy: Credits moved 0.81W -> 0.76W: at 0.81W the 18-character budget ran past the frame.
skill_text budget 78 -> 60 (3 lines x 20 fit the column); skill_note moved below the third line (it overlapped it).
skill_note colour accent -> accent_text #5A4100: the yellow measured below 2:1 on the panel.
Attribute chips start on the shared left line 0.052W (study 0.042W); attr_value budget 18 -> 13; name_cjk 5 -> 4 (5 characters cover the figure); series_latin 16 -> 15.

provenance.corpus: ignoredone's space gallery of official Arknights / Arknights: Endfield promotional art (© HYPERGRYPH), reference only, never redistributed
provenance.method: Our own structural skeleton from measured proportions (median of eye-annotated layout boxes, Lab colour measurements). No traced artwork, logos or official text; image and logo areas are hatched placeholder slots.
provenance.samples: Arknights DOSSIER_PORTRAIT, 6 images (AK038 measured); Endfield weapon dossiers, 3 images (EF084)
measured: frame inset 0.042W (AK038); name x 0.052W, y 0.15-0.19H; attribute rows 0.042-0.30W x 0.24-0.30H; divider 0.712H; skills 0.73-0.91H
name top-left 5/6; title area median 1.4%; figure takes 55% of the width
neutral pixels median 92%; the only chroma is red skill icons
